name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After a successful career in automotive manufacturing, he found himself drawn to the precision and relentless pursuit of performance that defined racing. He started volunteering at local racing events, offering his engineering expertise to smaller teams. His passion quickly grew, leading him to enroll in specialized motorsport engineering courses.

Ricardo approaches his role with a blend of meticulous planning and adaptable problem-solving. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their unique perspective. While relatively new to the highest levels of motorsport, his dedication to learning and his ability to quickly grasp complex concepts make him a valuable asset. He is particularly interested in exploring innovative materials and aerodynamic solutions to gain a competitive edge.

physical.description: Ricardo has a sturdy build, reflecting years spent working with machinery.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of pacing when deep in thought.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
